grammar.label: noun + noun, of-genitive or 's — choosing between them
grammar.form: a government report / a report of the government / the government's report
grammar.meaning: three ways to link two nouns, with different force

explanation.en: Noun + noun is the tightest and most headline-like: 'a government report'. The 's-genitive prefers a person or an organisation acting: 'the government's decision'. The of-genitive prefers abstractions and long phrases: 'the collapse of the old arrangement'.
explanation.uz: Ot+ot — eng ixcham shakl. ''s' odam yoki tashkilot harakati bilan keladi. 'of' esa mavhum tushuncha va uzun iboralar bilan ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: The collapse of the old arrangement surprised nobody.
grammar.negative_example: The old arrangement's collapse of surprised nobody.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilidagi izofa qurilmasi uchalasiga ham mos keladi, shuning uchun tanlov qiyin: mavhum tushuncha uchun 'of', shaxs uchun ''s'.

grammar.label: apposition — a second name for the same thing
grammar.meaning: identifies or explains without a relative clause

explanation.en: 'Kamola Rashidova, the head of the school, signed it' names the same person twice. Commas mark it as extra information; without commas it restricts, which changes the meaning: 'my brother Bobur' implies more than one brother.
explanation.uz: 'Kamola Rashidova, the head of the school, signed it' — bir shaxs ikki marta nomlanadi. Vergul qo'shimcha ma'lumotni bildiradi; vergulsiz shakl ma'noni cheklaydi.

grammar.positive_example: The registrar, a woman of thirty years' experience, refused.
grammar.negative_example: The registrar a woman of thirty years' experience refused.

l1_notes.uz: Vergulning bor-yo'qligi ma'noni o'zgartiradi — bu ingliz tinish belgilarining grammatik vazifasi.

body.text: This letter calls it 'the water supply of the reservoir of the district'.

body.text: Three of them in a row.

body.text: 'The district reservoir supply' is four words shorter.

body.text: And harder to read. Four nouns in a row with nothing between them.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then take the middle road. 'The supply from the district reservoir.'

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Next line. 'The school's computers' or 'the school computers'?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: The first if you mean the ones this school owns. The second if you mean the kind.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I mean the ones in room four.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: There is a whole paragraph here about the firewall.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Written by the man who put it in, I expect. Every sentence has five nouns in a row.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'Network authentication failure report log.' I have read it four times.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Break it open. 'The log of failed sign-ins, kept by the firewall.'

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Now a teacher can read it.

body.speaker: Kamola
